items.period: Shang period (oracle-bone script tradition; inscription catalogue label 鐵180.2 合5216)
items.tradition: Shang oracle-bone script; modern vector redraw
items.caption: A modern redraw of a Shang oracle-bone form of 日, traditionally interpreted as the sun; it shows the compact early graphic style before the later seal-script rendering.
items.alt: Black outline of an early 日 glyph, shown as a compact rounded enclosure with a central stroke.
items.selection_reason: Directly illustrates the early Shang form cited by the paleographic entry and supplies a contrast with the later seal-style redraw. The source labels it 42.ED48 and 鐵180.2 合5216; it is not an artifact photograph.
items.rights: CC0 1.0 / public domain dedication stated on the exact Commons file page; underlying Xiaoxuetang query-interface glyph image also covered by its official CC0 notice.

items.period: Han-era Shuowen seal-script tradition as represented in a modern redraw
items.tradition: Small seal script / Shuowen style; modern vector redraw
items.caption: A modern Shuowen-style seal-script rendering of 日. It provides a later standardized-looking form for comparison with the Shang oracle-script redraw.
items.alt: Black outline of 日 in a regular, vertically proportioned seal-script form.
items.selection_reason: Provides a useful later-script comparison while clearly identified as a redraw rather than a Han artifact image. Commons links the drawing to Xiaoxuetang record 27.65E5.
items.rights: CC0 1.0 / public domain dedication stated on the exact Commons file page; underlying Xiaoxuetang query-interface glyph image also covered by its official CC0 notice.

limitations.text: Both selected images are modern vector redrawings of script forms, not photographs or scans of ancient artifacts; captions should not present them as archaeological objects.
The candidate's period and form labels come from the Commons descriptions and their cited Xiaoxuetang record labels; exact Xiaoxuetang record pages were not independently opened in this run.
